findings.text: non-blocking: the animated assertion compares receipt["pixel_size"], which save_figure computes from the same figure the test sized from style.CANVAS, against style.CANVAS and never reads the written GIF, so a GIF exported at another pixel size leaves the test green.

non-blocking: the declared-size assertion reads receipt["declared_cm"], filled by the same _declared_size call that writes the SVG header, so skipping the header substitution at imas_codex/plotting/style.py:137-143 leaves it green, and the file-parsing guard at tests/plotting/test_signals.py:167-183 already owns that property in a stronger form.

non-blocking: the direct-label-over-data refusal now skips every visible line with an empty or underscore-prefixed label, so a label over an unlabelled data trace is no longer refused - a narrowing of an existing refusal landed inside a migration the plan says must not bypass the check.

non-blocking: the transparent title-strip rectangle is constructed a second time here, duplicating scripts/figures_knowledge_graph_scale.py:577-585 in a file that already imports FONT, SLATE, SYSTEMS, TITLE_SPACE and human from that module, so the strip reservation has two owners.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 4c66fcbc to a2cf01a77; e23349142 carries all code (style.py gains use_style, _declared_size and _text_boxes and save_figure's dpi/animation/fps/clear_of plus a receipt, ten scripts migrate, and each script-local check_layout, halo and slide-size literal is deleted), while 37311dcae and a2cf01a77 carry the landing record and the raster comparison.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's evidence fence asks for a recorded search, passing tests/plotting tests including a label-beyond-canvas refusal, each file's drawn/declared ratio within 1e-3, and a landing record listing the sizes before and after; the gate at a2cf01a77 (gate-plotting-tests.log) asserts only the test bullet - 30 passed, EXIT=0, with test_a_script_given_a_label_beyond_the_canvas_writes_no_file among them - while the search, the 3.57e-4 worst declared-versus-coordinate error and the 3 x 1400x720 GIF sizes live in measure-declared-ratios.log and the landing record, and I re-derived both from the head files (docs/figures/jt60sa-mapping-study/agreement.svg declares 31.1cm x 14.22cm against viewBox 1008x460.8).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that every figure script under scripts/ saves through the shared function with no check or export function of its own; at head grep finds 0 savefig( calls under scripts/ and all eleven matplotlib-using scripts import imas_codex.plotting.style.save_figure (scripts/plot_signal_enrichment_refinement.py:73 already did at base), and the one remaining helper, scripts/figures_discovery_to_mapping.py:311-313, calls the shared function twice and builds its receipt from the return value.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records three commits (e23349142, 37311dcae, a2cf01a77), the gate's 30 passed at a2cf01a77, the negative-control log whose header disables the clipped-text branch and whose run reports DID NOT RAISE with EXIT=1, and both suite arms as unreadable - baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log each abort at collection with EXIT=4, so neither carries a failed test id.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the 21 declared paths at prompt.txt:85-107 cover all 28 paths in the diff, checked path by path and none outside, including docs/evidence/fragments/figure-scripts-use-the-shared-save-function/figure-scripts-save-through-shared-function.html and the five docs/figures directories.

justifications.durability: only tests/plotting/test_figure_scripts.py:29 reddens on a reinstated defect (the negative control proves it), while no test fails if a script returns to savefig and the two receipt-reading assertions at tests/plotting/test_figure_scripts.py:59 and :80 hold whatever the written file contains.
justifications.evidence: the gate genuinely runs the label-beyond-canvas test at tests/plotting/test_figure_scripts.py:29 and is logged with its revision at gate-plotting-tests.log, but the ratio and declared-size measures the fence also asks for are recorded outside the gate in measure-declared-ratios.log rather than asserted by it.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/plotting/style.py:23-160 follows the module's existing shape - private helpers, one public entry point, ValueError refusals - and introduces no name the repository's naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every matplotlib-using script under scripts/ reaches imas_codex/plotting/style.py:83 save_figure (scripts/figures_ai_stack.py:599, scripts/figures_icp_knowledge_map.py:1158), and no script defines a text check or a slide-size constant.
justifications.reuse: use_style at imas_codex/plotting/style.py:23 extends the one owner of the packaged style and the three script-local check_layout copies are deleted rather than forked, but scripts/figures_mapping_flow.py:139 duplicates the title-strip rectangle at scripts/figures_knowledge_graph_scale.py:577 instead of extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: all 28 paths of the diff fall inside prompt.txt:85-107, and the only behavioural extra, scripts/figures_mapping_flow.py:252-256 writing only the draft PNG under --draft, is the pattern scripts/figures_ai_stack.py:593-596 already had at base.
